race.comment: VICTORY TUNE (4) looks hardest to beat and is going far better than the recent form suggests. Midfield in the Silver Bowl final at Flemington two back then midfield in a richer race at Seymour last time. Freshened and is coming back in trip but will find this easier and will stalk the pace and finish hard. Deserves a win. KING WEST (1) was coming off a very long break when fourth at Sale fresh. Will strip much fitter for it and expected to give a sight. GAME PLAN (9) is hard to beat on her best form and will wind up late. SNITCHY (13) got off the mark last time when saluting by 1.3 lengths at Wangaratta and is worth following up.
